subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Brothers, Fathers, Painters
solution:
The correct Venn diagram representation is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9850d210909710c51ecc04113ba2bf155e2ec68f33099314080ec47f69aab4.png] 

 
• A father can also be a brother and can also be a painter.
 
• A painter can be a father and brother of someone else.
 
• A brother can be a father of someone and can also be a painter.

Hence, **'option 2'** is the correct answer.
